name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Common Paper Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (MNDA) — allows two parties to disclose confidential information to each other under mutual confidentiality obligations.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement — governs the provision and use of a cloud-based product or service between a provider and customer.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement — grants an early customer access to a product in exchange for feedback during a design partnership program.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement — defines uptime targets, support response times, and service credits for a cloud service.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement — governs the provision of professional services and deliverables under one or more statements of work.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement — governs the processing of personal data between a controller/processor and a processor/subprocessor, including EEA SCCs and the UK Addendum.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement — licenses on-premises or client-side software for installation and use by a customer.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement — governs a business partnership between two companies, including trademark licensing and mutual obligations.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement — grants a customer temporary access to a product to evaluate it before entering a definitive agreement.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement — governs the use and protection of protected health information (PHI) between a covered entity and business associate under HIPAA.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper Standard AI Addendum — supplements an agreement with terms governing the use of AI services, including Input/Output ownership and model training rights.
